_comment: Install as %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity-cli\settings.json. Required for Run-Review.ps1 -Reviewer agy. Headless agy cannot prompt, so toolPermission must be always-proceed; edits are prevented by --mode plan (set by the launcher), and the deny list below is the backstop against shell-level writes. The terminal sandbox is off because it cannot execute commands on Windows Server 2019 (run exits 2 with no output). The CLI rewrites this file on startup and may reorder keys; that is harmless.
